chunks: There is Hell before them; and whatever they have earned will not avail them in the least, nor those whom they take as friends apart from God. There is great chastisement for them.
ai.seo_question: What will not benefit disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of worldly alliances and accumulated deeds when divorced from divine proximity, highlighting that neither material wealth nor political patrons can intercede on the Day of Judgment. It serves as a critical reminder of the ultimate accountability where human agency is tested against the sufficiency of God's mercy versus the inevitability of His justice.
